mapper.sql: h.id, h.building_id, h.house_no, h.unit_no, h.floor_no, h.room_no, h.area, h.house_type, h.orientation, h.status, h.owner_id, h.decoration, h.remark, h.create_time
, b.name AS building_name, o.name AS owner_name, o.phone AS owner_phone
FROM house h LEFT JOIN building b ON b.id = h.building_id LEFT JOIN owner o ON o.id = h.owner_id

where.if: AND (h.house_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR o.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR o.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO house (building_id, house_no, unit_no, floor_no, room_no, area, house_type, orientation, status, owner_id, decoration, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{buildingId}, #{houseNo}, #{unitNo}, #{floorNo}, #{roomNo}, #{area}, #{houseType}, #{orientation}, IFNULL(#{status}, 'EMPTY'), #{ownerId}, #{decoration}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM house GROUP BY status
SELECT house_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM house GROUP BY house_type ORDER BY value DESC
